facts.text: The README lists biped_controller.py as the main entrance for the biped controller
The constructor starts the sensor collector, waits for the first sample, and starts the motor loop on interface enp3s0
The constructor creates MotorController('enp3s0', CONTROL_MODE.CYCLIC_SYNC_TORQUE, 20, 1000.0) and calls run(), which starts the EtherCAT loop in the background
step() calls update_command(), update_observation(), check_termination() and compute_action(), then writes the computed target to motor.target_dof_position
update_command() copies the cmd array received from the UDP data receiver into self.commands and sets should_reset from the reset flag
The gamepad's command maxima are lin_vel_x_max 0.3, lin_vel_y_max 0.25 and ang_vel_z_max 0.2
The gamepad creates a DataPublisher for udp://localhost:9871 with msgpack and broadcast
The gamepad's Y axis scales lin_vel_x_max, its X axis scales ang_vel_z_max and its third axis scales lin_vel_y_max
The gamepad builds the cmd and reset message and publishes it
BipedController.shutdown() sets the motor loop's should_terminate flag, stops the sensor collector and stops the command receiver
The C++ motor loop runs while should_terminate is false; when it ends it leaves operational state, requests EtherCAT INIT for the slaves and closes the socket
check_termination() stops the motors and calls shutdown(), then exit(), when the base tilt exceeds 45 degrees or should_reset is set
set_should_terminate stores the flag the C++ run loop reads
set_max_torque stores the torque limit vector of the motors
The motor loop writes each motor's max_torque into its maximal-torque PDO entry
SerialDataCollector imports Process from multiprocessing
SerialDataCollector.start() runs read_loop in a Process; stop() sets running to False and joins the process; read_loop runs while running is true
MotorController sets num_dof to 10
MotorController.dof_pos returns dof_position, dof_vel returns dof_velocity_filtered and dof_current returns actual_torque
The C++ header defines dof_position and target_dof_position in rad and dof_velocity and dof_velocity_filtered in rad/s
The C++ header defines actual_torque in A
The command input of the upstream simple test states target position in rad in csp mode and target velocity in rad/s in csv mode
get_latest_data() returns force_measurement, contact, ang_vel, base_quat, gravity_vec and sps
force_measurement is the raw four-value load-cell reading and contact is true when the sum of the two values of a foot exceeds the two zero-contact minima by the threshold 400
The zero-contact minima are 730, 1020, 1000 and 780 raw counts and the threshold is 400, values that the comment says must match the actual sensor
sps is computed as 100 divided by the span of the timestamp ring buffer, in samples per second
The gravity vector is divided by GRAVITY before it is sent
The C++ header says to find the interface name with ifconfig
motor_controller.py opens motor_config.yaml in the working directory and reads motor_pos_offset from it
The constructor loads checkpoint/baseline/policy.onnx and checkpoint/baseline/config.yaml relative to the working directory
The README runs the controller from the clone root with sudo and another terminal for the gamepad

measures.description: Filtered angular velocity from the Teensy sample; the clone states no unit for it

measures.description: Gravity direction from the Teensy, divided by GRAVITY (dimensionless)
measures.name: gravity_vector

measures.description: Base orientation quaternion [x, y, z, w] from the Teensy sample
measures.name: base_quaternion

measures.description: Sensor sample rate computed from the timestamp buffer (sps)

operator_required.name: command_forward
operator_required.reason: the clone states no envelope for the command array: gamepad.py scales its stick axes into -0.3..0.3 (x), -0.25..0.25 (y) and -0.2..0.2 (yaw) before publishing (gamepad.py:6-8, 44-50), but BipedController copies whatever cmd array the UDP receiver delivers (biped_controller.py:315-321); the site states the allowed command

safe_state.description: every motor's torque limit is 0 and the EtherCAT motor loop has ended (it left operational state, requested INIT and closed the socket); the biped has no joint torque and falls unless it is supported; the sensor collector and the UDP command receiver keep running
